summary: Proofs are mostly robust simp/ring/abel scripts with no change/show and no overlong proofs, but the Minkowski-product proof rests on a 13-step order-sensitive rw chain, the same √2 arithmetic is written out three times, and six component lemmas close by unfolding a LinearEquiv structure literal.
